The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. a. 15% after issuance of the Work Order/Purchase Order. b. 10% after delivery of the systems. The Advance Bank Guarantee (ABG) shall be released after the final paym ent of the project. (ii) Final Payment (75%): The remaining 75% of the total contract value shall be released only after successful installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and acceptanc e of the complete system in accordance with the terms and conditions of t he contract.
